summary: Signal argument deserialization errors in workflows are logged using the default logger instead of the workflow-specific logger, making it difficult to diagnose issues. This differs from other deserialization errors which fail the task, while signal errors log-and-ignore to prevent workflow failure.
userImpact: Users cannot easily diagnose signal argument deserialization failures because error logs lack workflow-specific context information.
rootCause: Signal deserialization errors use the default logger instead of the workflow logger at _workflow_instance.py line 2316-2318.
proposedFix: Update signal deserialization error handling to use the workflow-specific logger for consistency with other deserialization errors.
keyQuote: the log is not using the workflow logger meaning there is not enough context to diagnose
